recordBoundary: Record of the literature checks made during production (session tool log, 7-10 October 2026; summary in paper/novelty_report.md), the source readings behind the paper's comparisons, and the limitation triage and extension scout before publication on 10 October 2026. Only checks that were actually run are listed. No absolute priority claim.

contributionMap.claim: Every three-agent instance with nonnegative additive valuations and at most eight goods admits a complete PMMS allocation; hence m* = 9

searches.query: PMMS allocations three agents eight goods existence minimum number of goods counterexample 2026 (extended web search), plus full-text reading of arXiv:2609.08954, 2609.10493, 2609.06282

contributionMap.closestPriorWork: Goelz arXiv:2609.08954 (nine-good counterexample; remark that he believes nine to be minimal or almost minimal, no theorem); Bei et al. arXiv:2609.10493 Table 2 (second nine-good instance); the seven-good existence note of 6 October 2026 (m* in {8,9}).

contributionMap.claim: Sign-abstraction SAT encoding of additive valuations with restriction-lemma injection, a Pareto/least-good normal form and least-agent sub-cases, verified by clause re-derivation and LRAT certificates

searches.query: same PMMS/minimum-goods search; seven-good note and memorandum of the input package as direct predecessors
Akrami Mayorov Mehlhorn Srinivas Weidenbach arXiv:2604.18216v3: encoding, Lean scope, proof checking

contributionMap.closestPriorWork: Akrami et al. arXiv:2604.18216v3 (SAT for EFX existence/counterexamples with a subset-order encoding, Lean-formalised reduction, DRAT checking); the seven-good note's sign abstraction; LRAT format of Cruz-Filipe et al. 2017.

contributionMap.claim: Sufficient condition for PMMS with 3q-1 goods: one q-balanced agent and v_c(P) <= v_c(M minus P)/2 for a second agent (equivalently 3 v_c(P) <= v_c(M)), strictly extending the two-balanced-agent cardinality theorem

searches.query: pairwise maximin share three agents 3q-1 top goods bottom goods cut-and-choose sufficient condition PMMS existence

contributionMap.closestPriorWork: The cardinality theorem of the 7 October 2026 memorandum (two balanced agents); Amanatidis, Markakis and Ntokos AAAI 2020 for m <= n+2. New as an existence statement only for q >= 4.

limitationTriage.limitation: The reduction is argued in the text, not formalised in a proof assistant
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there an existing formalisation of PMMS or of sign-abstraction encodings to build on?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: No formalisation was attempted or searched for; Akrami et al. (read 10 October) formalise a different reduction (subset order, EFX) in Lean
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Formalising the reduction is a substantial separate project

limitationTriage.limitation: The clause verifier and Python checker were written by the same producer as the generator
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can a third-party tool cover the same step?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Every certificate is also accepted by the third-party lrat-check; formula semantics rest on the written schemas and the separate verifier
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Independence of authorship cannot be produced by the producer

limitationTriage.limitation: A human-readable proof of Theorem 1 is not known
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does Proposition 7 or a known construction cover all instances?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Conjecture scout (data/conjecture_scout.json) and structure analysis: three natural strengthenings refuted by explicit instances
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Open mathematical question stated in Section 7

limitationTriage.limitation: Why the pair template fails on the instance of Observation 3(a)

limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: All fourteen proofs trimmed (111 GB untrimmed to about 33 GB): thirteen with lrat-trim, one with an external-memory trimmer (tools/lowmem_trim.c) after lrat-trim ran out of memory

limitationTriage.limitation: Historical priority rests on a bounded search
